Generated seccomp filter allowing write, fsync, and exit only for specific arguments.

# Purpose
This header defines a generated seccomp BPF policy for `fd_snapin_tile`. It builds a `sock_filter` program that checks the runtime architecture, then allows only `write`, `fsync`, and `exit` system calls under fixed argument rules. `write` is allowed only for file descriptor `2` or for `logfile_fd`, `fsync` is allowed only for `logfile_fd`, and `exit` is allowed only with status `0`. All other system calls, or calls with other arguments, are rejected with `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS`.
